launcher.notes: THE ACCOUNT LEFT THE DASHBOARD - the home screen is now a pure launch experience with zero account clutter: the titlebar chip and the always-open accounts card are gone, and your identity lives on a single avatar at the bottom of the navigation rail. Hover the avatar (or click it) and the account switcher opens right next to it; clicking pins it open, a second click closes it, and a hover-open closes itself shortly after your pointer moves away. Switch accounts with one click (the avatar updates instantly), add an offline nickname or sign in with Microsoft right inside the flyout; the full account manager still lives in Settings. The running status line no longer shows the username either. Same trusted launch pipeline: managed Java 8, Minecraft 1.8.9, Forge + OptiFine and the Kinetrix Client, prepared in the background and launched in seconds. Restart the launcher and accept the update prompt.
